data.title: IEEE Offers More Services to Cities That Want to Be Smarter

content.basic: More and more city governments are using advanced technologies to improve livability for their residents. Municipalities use data from smartphones and sensors for traffic enforcement, traffic control, and waste management. They also have implemented artificial intelligence and deep learning programs. Dubai, Paris, and Coral Gables, Fla., are among the cities that have invested heavily in programs to become smarter. data.title: ChatGPT can peek at your Chrome tabs now

content.basic: OpenAI's ChatGPT Atlas browser is gone, but now ChatGPT's Google Chrome extension is getting some upgrades that allow it to use the browser tabs you already have open. With the extension installed, OpenAI says ChatGPT can now view your browser tabs when you tag Chrome in ChatGPT's web or desktop app, posting a demo video showing someone asking ChatGPT to compare the three tabs they have open with sofas they're considering.
